newsitem.title: UK: BFI unchanged at 1,511, Handy Index up 10.
newsitem.headline: BFI unchanged at 1,511, Handy Index up 10.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was unchanged at 1,511 on Tuesday, while the new Handy Index on its third day was up 10 points at 1,022.

Brokers said firmer Caper rates in all areas have been cancelled out by slightly weaker Panamax rates in the Atlantic, although firmer levels for craned Panamaxes in the Far East were responsible for this improvement for Handy-size owners.
However, smaller Handy-sized tonnage continues to suffer from falling rates from the U.S. Gulf and East coast South America for grain business, they added.
